root_cause.mechanism: In parallel/parallel_multiple cases, ground truth in BFCL_V1_40.json is formatted as a single dict with suffixed keys (e.g. get_stock_price 1). bfcl_official passed this dict wrapped in a list, resulting in length 1 matching the model 1-tool-call output length, causing ast_checker parallel_function_checker_no_order to lookup find_description with suffixed key get_stock_price 1 which returned None, triggering TypeError in simple_function_checker. Additionally, if candidate output contains unknown/unresolved functions or malformed calls, ast_checker/bfcl_official did not fail closed.
